findings.title: No Documented API Interface
findings.description: The application exposes no REST, GraphQL, or AsyncAPI interface. It serves HTML pages via ColdFusion templates over HTTP. Integration would require direct database access or UI automation.
findings.gap: No programmatic API exists. The only integration surface is HTML pages.
findings.recommendation: Implement a REST API layer with JSON responses for document listing, search, and download operations.

findings.title: No Machine-Readable API Specification
findings.description: No OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, GraphQL schema, or machine-readable specification exists.
findings.gap: No machine-readable spec for agent tool generation.
findings.recommendation: Create OpenAPI 3.0 specification concurrent with REST API implementation.

findings.title: No Structured Error Responses
findings.description: No structured error responses. ColdFusion returns default HTML error pages on failure with no error codes or retry guidance.
findings.gap: Agents cannot distinguish retriable from terminal errors.
findings.recommendation: Implement structured JSON error responses with error codes and retryable indicators.

findings.title: No Idempotent Write Operations
findings.description: No idempotency controls exist. SQL queries use string concatenation with no idempotency keys. File uploads write directly to disk with original filenames.
findings.gap: Duplicate agent calls would create duplicate records/files with no deduplication.
findings.recommendation: Add idempotency key support to all write endpoints.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to BLOCKER: agent_scope=write-enabled AND no idempotency controls on write operations.
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: System performs write operations (file uploads, document creation) without idempotency keys. Agent retries would duplicate data.

findings.title: HTML-Only Response Format
findings.description: All responses are HTML. No JSON, XML, or structured machine-readable format is returned.
findings.gap: LLMs cannot consume HTML table output directly as structured data.
findings.recommendation: Implement JSON response format when building the REST API layer.

findings.title: No Event Emission for State Changes
findings.description: No event emission capability. No webhooks, SNS/EventBridge/SQS integration, or message queues.
findings.gap: Agents cannot react to document uploads or state changes without polling.
findings.recommendation: Consider EventBridge integration when modernizing.

findings.title: No Rate Limit Documentation or Headers
findings.description: No rate limit documentation or headers. No X-RateLimit-Remaining or Retry-After headers.
findings.gap: Agents cannot self-throttle based on system feedback.
findings.recommendation: Implement rate limit headers when deploying API Gateway.

findings.title: No Machine Identity Authentication
findings.description: Session-based authentication only. No OAuth2, API keys, mTLS, or service account support. The datasource password is 'cfadmin'.
findings.gap: No machine identity authentication. Cannot distinguish machine callers from human users.
findings.recommendation: Implement OAuth2 client credentials or API key authentication with principal attribution.

blocker_remediation.immediate: Implement API key authentication for machine callers
blocker_remediation.target_state: Machine identity authentication with principal attribution in audit logs

findings.title: No Scoped Permissions
findings.description: Binary authorization model — users are either authenticated or not. No role differentiation or permission scoping.
findings.gap: Cannot grant an agent read-only access to specific resources without inheriting full access.
findings.recommendation: Implement RBAC with role-per-agent-capability.

compensating_controls: API Gateway with IAM-based resource policies
Reverse proxy with path-based access controls

findings.title: No Action-Level Authorization
findings.description: No action-level authorization. Single session check does not distinguish between read and write operations.
findings.gap: Cannot enforce read-only access for an agent within the same resource type.
findings.recommendation: Implement fine-grained RBAC or ABAC with action-level checks.

compensating_controls: Application middleware with action type checking

findings.title: No Identity Propagation
findings.description: No identity propagation. ColdFusion session variables only. No JWT, OAuth token exchange, or on-behalf-of flows.
findings.gap: Cannot distinguish agent-as-self from agent-on-behalf-of-user.
findings.recommendation: Implement OAuth2 with token exchange supporting on-behalf-of flows.

compensating_controls: X-User-Id headers at API Gateway layer

findings.title: Hardcoded Credentials
findings.description: Credentials embedded in ColdFusion Administrator. README documents password as 'cfadmin'. No secrets management or rotation.
findings.gap: Hardcoded credentials with no rotation. Known password documented in source control.
findings.recommendation: Immediately rotate password and migrate to AWS Secrets Manager with automatic rotation.

findings.title: No Immutable Audit Logging
findings.description: No audit logging exists. No CloudTrail, no application-level audit logs, no immutable log storage.
findings.gap: No audit trail for any operations. Cannot prove compliance or conduct forensics.
findings.recommendation: Implement immutable audit logging with principal attribution (CloudTrail + S3 Object Lock).

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to BLOCKER: agent_scope=write-enabled AND no audit logging for write operations.
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: Write-enabled agents require immutable audit trails for compliance. No logging exists.

findings.title: No Agent Identity Suspension
findings.description: No mechanism to suspend or revoke individual agent identities. Session-based system has no revocable machine identities.
findings.gap: Cannot isolate a misbehaving agent without shutting down the entire application.
findings.recommendation: Implement revocable API keys or OAuth2 client credentials with individual disable capability.

findings.title: No Compensation or Rollback
findings.description: No compensation or rollback mechanism. Direct SQL with no transaction management. SQL injection compounds the issue.
findings.gap: Failed multi-step operations leave system in partial state with no recovery mechanism.
findings.recommendation: Implement database transactions with rollback and saga pattern for multi-step operations.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to BLOCKER: agent_scope=write-enabled AND no rollback/compensation for write operations.
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: System performs write operations without transaction management or compensation logic. Agent-initiated failures create irrecoverable partial states.

findings.title: No Machine-Readable Queryable State
findings.description: Document listing available via HTML only. No API endpoints return current resource state in machine-readable format.
findings.gap: Cannot programmatically inspect state before taking action.
findings.recommendation: Implement JSON GET endpoints for document state and collection queries.

findings.title: No Concurrency Controls
findings.description: No concurrency controls. No optimistic locking, version fields, ETags, or conditional writes.
findings.gap: Concurrent agent writes would create race conditions and data corruption.
findings.recommendation: Add version fields and implement optimistic locking on all write operations.

compensating_controls: ETag-based optimistic locking at API layer

findings.title: No Rate Limiting
findings.description: No rate limiting at any layer. No API Gateway, WAF, or application-level throttling middleware.
findings.gap: No protection against agent traffic storms or runaway loops on single-instance server.
findings.recommendation: Deploy API Gateway with usage plans and throttling configuration.

findings.title: No Blast Radius or Transaction Limits
findings.description: No transaction limits. No per-session operation caps or business-domain constraints.
findings.gap: Agent errors have unlimited blast radius — unbounded records affected per operation.
findings.recommendation: Implement configurable per-caller transaction limits.

findings.title: No Draft/Pending State
findings.description: No draft or pending state concept. All write operations are immediately committed with no reviewable intermediate state.
findings.gap: No mechanism for agent to propose changes for human review before commitment.
findings.recommendation: Add status field (DRAFT/PENDING/PUBLISHED) with explicit approval step.

findings.title: No Configurable Approval Gates
findings.description: No configurable approval gates. All operations execute immediately without human oversight.
findings.gap: Cannot configure specific operations to require human approval before execution.
findings.recommendation: Implement configurable approval gates for high-risk operations.

findings.title: No Sandbox/Staging Environment
findings.description: No sandbox or staging environment. Single production EC2 instance with manual file copy deployment.
findings.gap: No safe environment to test agent behavior before production.
findings.recommendation: Create containerized staging environment with production-equivalent data shape.

findings.title: Sensitive Data Exposed Without Scoping
findings.description: System stores user-specific data (userid, fullname, uploaded_by) and corporate documents. SQL queries return all columns without field filtering. No access differentiation.
findings.gap: B1: All fields exposed without filtering. B2: No access control differentiation. B3: No formal classification.
findings.recommendation: Implement field-level response filtering and role-based data access differentiation.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to BLOCKER: agent_scope=write-enabled AND B1 fired — sensitive fields returned without scoping.
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: Agent-facing responses expose all database columns including user identity fields. No field filtering mechanism exists.

b1.reasoning: SQL SELECT returns all fields (uploaded_by, user identity) without exclusion in index.cfm.

b2.reasoning: Single session check grants access to all documents. No differentiation between roles.

b3.reasoning: No formal data classification metadata exists.

findings.title: No Data Residency Controls
findings.description: No data residency controls. Corporate documents stored on local D: drive with no compliance framework or region-specific controls.
findings.gap: No safeguards against cross-jurisdiction data movement when agent transmits to LLM provider.
findings.recommendation: Classify data for residency requirements and implement region-locked storage.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to BLOCKER: agent_scope=write-enabled AND corporate documents stored without residency controls.
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: System stores corporate policy documents with no data sovereignty controls. An agent transmitting this data to an LLM provider in another jurisdiction has no guardrails.

findings.title: No Pagination or Selective Query
findings.description: No pagination. SQL returns all matching documents without LIMIT or OFFSET. Result sets are unbounded.
findings.gap: Agents would receive unbounded result sets exhausting LLM context windows.
findings.recommendation: Implement cursor-based pagination with configurable page size.

findings.title: No Input Validation — SQL Injection Vulnerable
findings.description: No input validation. url.q parameter directly concatenated into SQL (SQL injection). url.id used without type checking. No parameterized queries or sanitization.
findings.gap: All inputs accepted without validation. SQL injection and path traversal possible.
findings.recommendation: Replace all SQL string concatenation with cfqueryparam immediately. Implement comprehensive input validation.

findings.title: Partial Temporal Metadata, No Freshness Signaling
findings.description: Partial temporal metadata — uploaded_on field exists. No timezone normalization, no Cache-Control headers, no freshness indicators.
findings.gap: Limited temporal metadata with no mechanism to signal data freshness to agents.
findings.recommendation: Normalize timestamps to UTC, add updated_at field, implement Cache-Control headers.

findings.title: No PII Redaction in Logs
findings.description: No PII redaction. User data (session.fullname, uploaded_by) output directly. ColdFusion default logging may capture user data unmasked.
findings.gap: PII potentially captured in logs without masking.
findings.recommendation: Implement PII masking in all log outputs and configure log retention with access controls.

compensating_controls: Disable request parameter logging in ColdFusion

findings.title: No Data Quality Awareness
findings.description: No data quality metrics, completeness scores, or freshness SLAs exist.
findings.gap: Cannot assess data reliability before agent action.
findings.recommendation: Implement basic data quality monitoring for the documents table.

findings.title: No Schema Versioning or API Contracts
findings.description: No schema versioning, API contracts, or breaking change detection. No versioned URLs, changelog, or database migrations.
findings.gap: No mechanism to detect or communicate breaking changes to agent tool bindings.
findings.recommendation: Implement API versioning from day one with contract testing in CI.

findings.title: No Data Catalog or Metadata Layer
findings.description: No data catalog, metadata layer, or schema documentation describing what data the system holds.
findings.gap: Agent tool builders must reverse-engineer the data model from source code.
findings.recommendation: Document the data model and consider AWS Glue Data Catalog integration.

findings.title: No Distributed Tracing or Structured Logging
findings.description: No distributed tracing (X-Ray, OpenTelemetry). No structured logging. No correlation IDs.
findings.gap: Cannot debug agent-initiated requests. No traceability.
findings.recommendation: Implement OpenTelemetry/X-Ray with structured JSON logging and request correlation IDs.

findings.title: No Alerting on Error Rates or Latency
findings.description: No alerting configured. No CloudWatch alarms, monitoring thresholds, or anomaly detection.
findings.gap: System degradation undetectable until agent failures cascade.
findings.recommendation: Deploy CloudWatch alarms on HTTP 5xx rates and p95 latency.

findings.title: No Infrastructure as Code
findings.description: No IaC. Manual deployment via network file copy. No Terraform, CloudFormation, or CDK. No peer review. No drift detection.
findings.gap: No IaC governance for agent-facing infrastructure.
findings.recommendation: Define all infrastructure in Terraform/CDK with PR-based review.

findings.title: No CI/CD Pipeline
findings.description: No CI/CD pipeline. Manual file copy deployment. No automated testing or contract validation.
findings.gap: API breaking changes cannot be caught before production.
findings.recommendation: Implement CI/CD pipeline with automated tests and API contract validation.

findings.title: No Rollback Capability
findings.description: No rollback. Manual file copy with no versioning, blue/green, or canary deployments.
findings.gap: Cannot quickly rollback agent-breaking deployments.
findings.recommendation: Implement automated deployment with rollback capability (CodeDeploy or containers).

findings.title: No API Test Coverage
findings.description: No automated tests. No test files, framework, or directories. Zero test coverage.
findings.gap: No tests validating API behavior, input handling, or error responses.
findings.recommendation: Implement automated test suite covering API endpoints and error handling.

findings.title: No Encryption at Rest
findings.description: No encryption at rest. Local disk storage and SQL Server 2005 (no TDE support). No KMS.
findings.gap: Data at rest unencrypted. Breach exposes all documents and database contents.
findings.recommendation: Migrate to S3 with KMS encryption and RDS with encryption enabled.

evaluations.title: Asynchronous Operation Support
evaluations.reason: Extended question not triggered — no operations >30s or long-running workflows detected in this stateful-crud service.

evaluations.title: Circuit Breakers and Resilience
evaluations.reason: Extended question not triggered — service does not call other services or external APIs.

evaluations.title: Graceful Degradation Signaling
evaluations.reason: Extended question not triggered — no P0 priority or critical path designation.

evaluations.title: Semantically Meaningful Field Names
evaluations.reason: Field names are human-readable and semantically meaningful (doc_id, title, category, uploaded_by, uploaded_on, filename). No legacy abbreviations.

evaluations.title: Business Outcome Metrics
evaluations.reason: No metrics or telemetry surface exists at all — informational signal, no finding emitted.

items.summary: Resolve all 7 BLOCKERs and critical RISK-SAFETY findings. Focus on machine identity (AUTH-Q1), API surface (API-Q1), and audit logging (AUTH-Q6) as foundational controls.
Address remaining RISK-SAFETY and RISK-QUALITY findings. Build engineering maturity, observability, and deploy infrastructure governance.
Address INFO findings and remaining quality improvements. Implement event emission, test coverage, and data quality monitoring.

recommended_actions.action: Implement REST API with machine identity authentication
recommended_actions.rationale: The system has no programmatic API and no machine identity. These are the two foundational BLOCKERs that gate all other agent integration work.

recommended_actions.action: Deploy centralized identity and authorization framework
recommended_actions.rationale: Without scoped permissions, action-level auth, and identity suspension, agents cannot be safely scoped or contained.

recommended_actions.action: Implement audit logging and credential management
recommended_actions.rationale: Immutable audit logging is a compliance BLOCKER. Hardcoded credentials are a known exposure.
Sensitive data exposed without scoping and no residency controls are BLOCKERs. PII in logs compounds the risk.

recommended_actions.action: Build state management and safety controls
recommended_actions.rationale: No rollback, no idempotency, no concurrency controls, and no rate limiting make write operations unsafe for agents.

recommended_actions.action: Establish CI/CD pipeline and infrastructure as code
recommended_actions.rationale: Manual deployment with no testing, no rollback, and no IaC governance cannot safely support agent-facing services.
